xna-type.name: GraphicsDeviceCapabilities.AddressCaps
xna-type.summary: Represents the texture addressing capabilities for Texture structures.

property.name: SupportsBorder
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device supports the setting of coordinates outside the range [0.0, 1.0] to the border color.
property.value: true if the device supports the setting of coordinates outside the range to the border color; false otherwise.

property.name: SupportsClamp
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device supports the clamping of textures to addresses.
property.value: true if the device supports clamping textures to addresses; false otherwise.

property.name: SupportsIndependentUV
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device can separate the texture-addressing modes of the texture's u and v coordinates.
property.value: true if the device supports separating the texture-addressing modes of the u and v coordinates; false otherwise.

property.name: SupportsMirror
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether a device can mirror textures to addresses.
property.value: true if the device supports mirroring textures to addresses; false otherwise.

property.name: SupportsMirrorOnce
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether a device can take the absolute value of the texture coordinate (thus, mirroring around 0) and then clamp to the maximum value.
property.value: true if the device can mirror once; false otherwise.

property.name: SupportsWrap
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether a device can wrap textures to addresses.
property.value: true if the device can wrap textures to addresses; false otherwise.

method.name: ToString
method.summary: Retrieves a string representation of this object.

overload.summary: Retrieves a string representation of this object.
